subject: Court Closure
issuer: Multnomah County Circuit Court — Presiding Judge
title: Multnomah County Circuit Court Presiding Judge Order — 2101-00000 (3); Court Closure
text:
IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE STATE OF OREGON
FOR MULTNOMAH COUNTY
In the Matter of Emergency
Courthouse Closure
PRESIDING JUDGE ORDER NO. 2101-00000
ORDER RE EMERGENCY COURTHOUSE CLOSLJ. fi'
'
Due to inclement weather the following courthouse facilities will be closed on Friday, February 12,
2021: the Main Courthouse, Justice Center, Juvenile Justice Center, and East County Courthouse.
Remote telephone and video hearings will be held Friday, February 12, 2021. These include morning
call/trial assignments for felony and civil cases; Trial Readiness Conferences in misdemeanor cases;
Landlord Tenant/FED Cases; and all civil, family law, and criminal matters that have been scheduled with
individual judicial departments.
\ -,
C>
Arraignments for both Misdemeanor and Felony cases scheduled at the Justice Center will not be held
and will be set over to Tuesday, February 16, 2021. Preliminary hearings at the Juvenile Justice Center for
both Delinquency and Dependency cases will be set over to Tuesday, February 16, 2021. Five and twenty­one
day contested protection order hearings will be reset.
~
DATED this_il_day of February, 2021.
Presiding Judge
Multnomah County Circuit Court
